# MD View 1.0.0-rc.3

The third public release candidate of MD View: a native Markdown, text, and code editor for
Windows, macOS, and Linux, built with Rust and egui. No webview. 1.0.0-rc.2 was prepared but not
published; its changes are part of this release.

## Highlights

- **The editor behaves.** Enter and Space no longer move the cursor to the mouse pointer (Enter
  split the line wherever the mouse rested), typing no longer recentres the view, and up/down
  never jump into the next line from a short one. Tab and Shift+Tab indent instead of leaving the
  editor, and dragging selects from where the button went down.
- **Markdown formatting bar.** Markdown files get a GitHub-style bar above the editor: headings,
  bold, italic, underline, quote, code, link, a Word-style table picker on a grid, and bulleted,
  numbered, and task lists. Buttons toggle and show the formats under the cursor;
  `Ctrl/Cmd+B/I/U/K` and the **Format: …** palette commands do the same.
- **Lists and tables that continue as you type.** Enter continues a list and renumbers it, Enter
  on an empty item leaves the list (a nested item first moves up a level), Tab nests. In tables,
  Tab moves between cells, adds rows, and realigns the columns.
- **Clean soft wrap.** Rows break after whole words, wrapped rows no longer repeat text, and the
  cursor, selection, and search matches line up with the text, including after tabs.
- **Chinese, Japanese, and Korean text** is drawn with an installed system font instead of empty
  boxes, and wide characters keep the editor grid aligned.
- **Fast typing in large files.** Edits re-measure only the lines they touch: under 1 ms per key in
  a 210,000-line file, where each key used to re-measure the whole document.
- **Find and replace.** Enter finds the next match and keeps focus in the panel, regex mode
  matches `^`/`$` per line and expands `$1` in replacements, and the panel no longer shifts while
  typing. Enter works in Go to Line and the search popover.
- **Explorer and tabs.** Files and folders align, keyboard navigation works after a click,
  context menus are compact, and the tab strip scrolls to the active tab with long names ending
  in "…".
- **From the unpublished rc.2:** split view ends together with exact sync, the editor has focus
  without a click, **Insert LaTeX Block** (`Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+M`), a steady editor end, and Alt keys
  no longer type into the editor.

Everything from 1.0.0-rc.1 and 1.0.0-rc.0 is included: flicker-free split view, GitHub Markdown
parity, Oniguruma highlighting, the explorer that follows tabs, and the desktop packages.

## Install

Download the asset for your platform and verify it against `SHA256SUMS`:

| Platform | Preferred asset |
|---|---|
| Linux | `MD-View-1.0.0-rc.3-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Debian / Ubuntu | `mdview_1.0.0.rc.3_amd64.deb` |
| Fedora / RPM | `mdview-1.0.0.rc.3-1.x86_64.rpm` |
| macOS | `MD-View-1.0.0-rc.3-macOS-arm64.dmg` |
| Windows | `MD-View-1.0.0-rc.3-windows-x86_64.msi` |

The macOS and Windows RC builds are **unsigned**. Gatekeeper and SmartScreen may ask for an extra
confirmation. Signing and notarization remain final 1.0.0 release-operator steps.

Documentation: https://jigonzalez930209.github.io/md-view-rs/

## Checksums and SBOM

The release includes a combined `SHA256SUMS`, `latest.json`, and `sbom.cdx.json`. Use
`sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` on Linux/macOS or `Get-FileHash` on Windows.

Full changelog: https://github.com/jigonzalez930209/md-view-rs/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
